subject.title: fix: surface OpenAI chat-completions refusal as assistant text

question: Should maintainers treat this PR as the canonical landing candidate for the OpenAI chat-completions refusal-drop fix once the unrelated red CI shard is rerun or classified?
rationale: The code path and proof are strong, but there are competing open candidate PRs for the same issue and a non-touched CI shard is red, so a maintainer needs to choose the landing branch rather than automation closing or merging around that context.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Merge this PR after CI is clear or classified, then let it close the linked issue and close duplicate refusal-fix candidates such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102342.

options.title: Choose the sibling PR
options.body: A maintainer can choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102342 instead, but it should first meet the same shared-provider coverage and proof bar.

options.title: Request consolidation
options.body: Ask the contributors to consolidate into one branch if maintainers do not want to pick between competing implementations directly.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after CI is clear or classified, then let it close the linked issue and close duplicate refusal-fix candidates such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102342.
